summary: Most core marketing-site and inquiries features appear implemented: single-page sections (Hero/Services/About/Contact) with sticky nav and smooth scrolling, pink/gold theme variables, a contact form with validation + confirmation state, and a backend/“Inquiries” admin view with persistence. One key backend data requirement (timestamp per inquiry) is not present in the diff. Several authentication/access-control and user-profile capabilities were added beyond the request.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend stores each inquiry with timestamp and submitted fields.
missing_requirements.reason: The Inquiry type stored in the Motoko backend includes id, name, contactInfo, serviceInterested, and message, but no timestamp field is stored or populated during submission.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile system (get/save user profile) with permission checks.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not ask for any user profile feature; only inquiry submission and listing are required.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity login/logout UI and auth-gated admin access (RequireAuth/RequireAdmin) for viewing inquiries.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest requires an internal “Inquiries” view/page but does not require adding authentication/Internet Identity or role-based access control to gate that page.

hallucinated_features.description: Access control initialization via secret URL parameter (caffeineAdminToken) and actor initialization hook logic.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested; BuildRequest does not mention secret tokens, URL parameter-based admin bootstrap, or access control mixins.
